description.narrative: This activity is a feasibility study to assess redevelopment options for Sir Robert’s Wharf, Alofi, Niue to inform Government of Niue and development partners. In 2018/19, the Government of Niue (GoN) requested assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB). This led to a pre-feasibility report on developing and improving port operations and facilities at the Wharf. This report identified four possible options and recommended further investigations and design development to assess feasibility.
